primary_outcome: final feasible_mean_nonroot_loss after the final update, lower is better
primary_comparison: nonleaf_extreme_coverage_ens minus pev, paired by seed
secondary_comparison: nonleaf_extreme_coverage_ens minus pev_var, paired by seed
analysis: Report all 20 paired differences, their mean, 95% two-sided t interval, and two-sided paired t p-value. The primary claim that endpoint coverage is better requires mean difference below zero with its 95% interval entirely below zero. Report the secondary comparison descriptively; do not replace a failed primary gate with the secondary. No best-checkpoint selection, seed dropping, or post hoc metric switching.
validation: All 60 schema-v3 cells must have complete receipts, finite final metrics, exactly 2000 environment samples, 32 executed actions, zero candidate-probe samples, matching graph/forms/coefficients across three arms within each seed, and endpoint values exactly ±5 for coverage. Copy complete artifacts locally and verify CURC/local checksums before analysis.
scope: Twenty fresh seeds and distinct DAGs drawn from the same five-layer hierarchical graph generator and shifted function-family generator as prior studies. This tests replication within that generator; it is not an independent external environment or a different graph generator. No closed-source model calls.
